name: ReddTrends
tagline: Find relevant Reddit threads and monitor your replies
description: ReddTrends helps product teams and marketers find Reddit threads ranking on Google and appearing in AI-search answers for their buyer keywords. It identifies relevant discussions, recommends which threads to join and offers reply guidance, then monitors weekly whether your comment remains and how the thread ranks and is cited. You decide whether to participate and reply from your own Reddit account; ReddTrends does not post for you and does not sell accounts, upvotes, or placements. A free preview gives three thread verdicts without an account or credit card. Paid options include a $9 one-time report, Pro at $19/month, and Agency at $49/month; the launch offer runs through December 15, 2026.
